# sigma_member (Data Source)

Look up a single member by `id` (preferred when known) or by `email`. Email lookups are case-insensitive and page through `/v2.1/members` client-side — they short-circuit on the first match, but on large orgs `id` lookups are faster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Member's email address. Matched case-insensitively.
- `id` (String) Sigma member UUID.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `member_type` (String)
- `user_kind` (String)
